technical.title: LiDAR Transformers improve autonomous driving perception in adverse weather conditions
technical.summary: New full-waveform LiDAR methods use intensity-guided token reduction and physics-aware augmentation to solve computational bottlenecks and data scarcity in autonomous driving sensors.
technical.why: This directly improves robust perception for autonomous vehicles operating in adverse weather.

technical.title: HITCH teaches vision-language models to operate humanoids via whole-body harnesses
technical.summary: HITCH combines a 3D perception harness and whole-body motion trackers to let vision-language models directly control humanoid robots across various tasks.
technical.why: This bridges high-level VLM reasoning with low-level humanoid robot control.

technical.title: Wide view synthesis method integrates overlapping cameras in autonomous driving
technical.summary: A new formulation for wide view synthesis addresses 3D geometry, visibility, and depth-dependent parallax to combine multiple perspective cameras in self-driving systems.
technical.why: It tackles core multi-camera perception and reconstruction challenges in autonomous driving.

technical.title: PSGAgent enhances MLLM dynamic visual perception for panoptic scene graphs
technical.summary: PSGAgent introduces a think-act-observe loop to help MLLMs overcome static resolution limits and accurately detect small objects and ambiguous relations.
technical.why: This improves fine-grained visual scene understanding for complex robot environments.

technical.title: SwarmEvolve enables latent agent swarms for rapid evolutionary optimization
technical.summary: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary search by using low-cost agents that reason in latent space and share KV caches instead of generating text.
technical.why: It provides a faster, more efficient way to optimize code and mathematical models.

technical.title: Text-to-image generators queried via own images for lesion segmentation
technical.summary: Researchers improve skin lesion segmentation without masks by leveraging directional alignments from healthy and lesion images generated by diffusion transformers.
technical.why: It presents a novel approach to zero-shot medical image segmentation using generative models.

technical.title: Open-source 3D-printed anthropomorphic arm developed for collaborative service robots
technical.summary: A new dissertation details an open-source 3D-printed arm and hand built to help service robots work alongside humans.
technical.why: It provides open hardware designs relevant to robotic manipulation engineering.

technical.title: GPT-6 Cyber introduced as an aligned cybersecurity agent for vulnerability finding
technical.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model trained to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes within authorized scopes.
technical.why: It represents the cutting edge of autonomous security tooling and model alignment.

technical.title: Zyphra releases ZYFA FP8 FlashAttention kernels for AMD MI355X GPUs
technical.summary: Zyphra's open-source ZYFA prefill attention kernels run up to 1.76x faster than AMD's AITER on real model activations with low error rates.
technical.why: It offers significant performance boosts for running LLMs on AMD hardware.

technical.title: ToyBlocks provides a controlled virtual world for robot learning
technical.summary: A controlled environment is introduced to assist with robot learning and evaluation tasks.
technical.why: It serves as a potential benchmarking tool for robotics simulation.

business.title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350 Million to Boost AI
business.summary: Dropbox announced it will acquire Tigris Data for $350 million, marking its largest acquisition since 2007. The deal supports the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.
business.why: This affects infrastructure strategies for developers building AI models and agents.

business.title: Dropbox Announces $350 Million Acquisition of Tigris Data
business.summary: Dropbox is buying Tigris Data for $350 million in its biggest acquisition yet. The transaction is designed to bolster its AI infrastructure and support the upcoming DBX Agent Cloud storage platform.
business.why: It highlights major storage infrastructure investments being made for AI developer platforms.

business.title: General Catalyst Tops Lead Investors For October In Busy Month For US Startup Dealmaking

business.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
business.summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

business.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
business.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

business.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
business.summary: Voters across the country on Tuesday voiced their support for candidates who have pledged to place restrictions on data center development.

business.title: Crunchbase Data: Less Than 2% Of 2026 Venture Funding Went To Post-Election Red States
business.summary: So far this year, less than 2% of all startup investment has gone to companies in post-election red states, a share that is much smaller than in years past due to five states shifting to purple in the most recent electio

business.title: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue being delayed due to customer request
business.summary: Following a dramatic plunge in its stock price, IREN said some revenue is being delayed from 2026 until early next year.

business.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes a 'war of attrition'
business.summary: The election rout landed on an AI trade already under pressure from high interest rates, heavy capital spending and questions about returns.

business.title: AI is the new dating dealbreaker
business.summary: When Irene moved to San Francisco last year, she started using dating apps as a way to meet new people, get to know her new city, and connect with others who care about the things she does. After the 25-year-old analyst

models.title: Idol turns a single image into a 3D Gaussian splat
models.summary: Idol takes a single photo, render, or generated image, removes the background, and generates up to 1,048,576 3D Gaussians in a .ply file, including unseen sides, running in under 2 seconds on consumer GPUs.
models.why: This provides a fast, consumer-hardware-friendly pipeline for single-image 3D reconstruction relevant to computer vision tasks.

models.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro multimodal agentic model
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic 2.8T MoE model with a 1-million-token context window, delivering improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research, and factual accuracy.
models.why: Its large context window and 3D creation capabilities are valuable for advanced computer vision and agentic engineering workflows.

models.title: Mid-pretraining checkpoint for numbat model leaked
models.summary: A 7.72 TB checkpoint from Anthropic's training run codenamed numbat features a ~14T parameter hybrid GDN/MLA MoE architecture with 1,224 experts and NVFP4 precision.
models.why: It offers a rare look into the architecture of next-generation large language model training runs.

models.title: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe audio model
models.summary: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model supporting transcription across 40 languages with up to one-hour recordings and a 65,536-token context.
models.why: It expands multimodal audio transcription capabilities using a hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture.

models.title: Ricursive Intelligence releases Ripple-65B Preview model
models.summary: Ripple-65B Preview is a 65B parameter dense Transformer pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with 1 million context support, achieving strong agentic coding benchmarks.
models.why: It demonstrates high-performance dense model scaling for advanced coding and reasoning agents.

models.title: Qwen releases weights for Qwen3.8-27B model
models.summary: The repository contains model weights and configuration files for the post-trained Qwen3.8-27B model, compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang.
models.why: It provides an accessible open-weight base model for scalable local or hosted inference deployment.
